title: Dexcom API Access Application Process
description: Step-by-step checklist for applying for Dexcom API access as researched from developer.dexcom.com

steps.title: Initial Registration
steps.description: Register as a Dexcom Developer at developer.dexcom.com
steps.outcome: Access to sandbox environment, app creation, support requests

steps.title: Create Your First App
steps.description: Create an app profile to get API credentials

steps.title: Study API Documentation
steps.description: Review endpoint overview, authentication flows, and data scopes
required_info: Data scopes: EGV, Calibrations, Events, Device Details

steps.title: Implement Sandbox Testing
steps.description: Build and test your app using sandbox data
required_info: Test with provided sandbox user accounts
steps.outcome: Functional app prototype with fake data

steps.title: Complete Development
steps.description: Build full app functionality and user interface

steps.title: Determine Partnership Type
steps.description: Choose your application path based on use case
steps.notes: AVA Type 1 would be commercial app developer

steps.title: Prepare Partnership Assets
steps.description: Assemble required documentation for Limited Access application
required_info: User privacy and data handling policies

steps.title: Apply for Limited Access
steps.description: Submit application through My Apps section or Partnership Interest Questionnaire
required_info: Completed app profile in My Apps

steps.title: Dexcom Partnership Review
steps.description: Wait for Dexcom Strategic Partnerships team review
required_info: Respond promptly to any follow-up questions

steps.title: Sign Data Licensing Agreement
steps.description: Review and agree to Dexcom's standard, non-negotiable terms

steps.title: Test with Real Users
steps.description: Use Limited Access to test with up to 5 real Dexcom users
required_info: Recruit test users (can include yourself if T1D)
Test OAuth flow with real accounts
steps.outcome: Validated app performance with real data
steps.notes: Perfect for testing with your own family

steps.title: Refine and Optimize
steps.description: Improve app based on real-world testing feedback
required_info: Bug fixes from real data testing

steps.title: Apply for Full Access
steps.description: Submit Full Access Questionnaire through My Apps
steps.notes: Need to show real user demand

steps.title: Technical & Commercial Review
steps.description: Pass Dexcom's comprehensive app review process
steps.outcome: Full Access approval or feedback for improvements

steps.title: Launch as Digital Health Partner
steps.description: Go live with unlimited user access and partnership benefits
steps.outcome: Full commercial access to Dexcom API

important_notes: Each app requires separate review - not per developer
Limited Access allows 5 users maximum for testing
Full Access requires active users within 60 days of launch
Data Licensing Agreement terms are non-negotiable
Must comply with FDA regulations for digital health
Commercial apps should use dexcom.com/b2b pathway
Process can take 3-6 months from start to full access
